20. (Currently amended) An analyte sensor system comprising:
an implantable analyte sensor configured to be inserted into a host and continuously monitor at least one analyte;
a sensor mounting unit, the implantable analyte sensor coupled to the sensor mounting unit;
and an adhesive pad coupled to the implantable analyte sensor mounting unit to adhere the sensor mounting unit to a skin surface of [[a]] the host; [[and]] a first heating element included in the adhesive pad and positioned to provide heat to the skin surface of the host when the implantable analyte sensor is inserted into the host;
sensor electronics hardware, wherein the sensor electronics hardware is configured to perform operations comprising:
detecting that the implantable analyte sensor has been inserted into the host, and
responsive to detecting insertion of the implantable analyte sensor into the host, providing power to the first heating element.
21. (Currently amended) The analyte sensor system of claim 20, An analyte sensor system comprising:
an implantable analyte sensor configured to be inserted into a host and continuously monitor at least one analyte;
a sensor mounting unit, the implantable analyte sensor coupled to the sensor mounting unit;
and an adhesive pad coupled to the implantable analyte sensor mounting unit to adhere the sensor mounting unit to a skin surface of the host; and
a first heating element included in the adhesive pad and positioned to provide heat to the skin surface of the host when the implantable analyte sensor is inserted into the host, wherein the
first heating element comprises at least a first reactant that reacts in the presence of air to generate heat.
22. (Currently amended) The analyte sensor system of claim 20, further comprising:
sensor eloctronics hardware, wherein the sensor electronics hardware is configured to provide power to wherein the first heating element includes an electrically resistive material.
23. (Currently amended) The analyte sensor system of claim 22, wherein the sensor electronics hardware is configured to perform operations comprising:
detecting that the implantable analyte sensor has been inserted into a host;
beginning to provide power to the first heating element; and
after a first time period, ceasing to provide power to the first heating element.
24. (Currently amended) The analyte sensor system of claim 20, further comprising: An analyte sensor system comprising:
an implantable analyte sensor configured to be inserted into a host and continuously monitor at least one analyte;
a sensor mounting unit, the implantable analyte sensor coupled to the sensor mounting unit;
and an adhesive pad coupled to the implantable analyte sensor mounting unit to adhere the sensor mounting unit to a skin surface of the host; and
a first heating element included in the adhesive pad and positioned to provide heat to the skin surface of the host when the implantable analyte sensor is inserted into the host, and
a sensor electronics unit installable to the sensor mounting unit, wherein the sensor electronics unit is configured to begin providing power to the first heating element after being installed to the sensor mounting unit.
25. (Previously Presented) The analyte sensor system of claim 20, wherein the adhesive pad comprises a permeability-enhancing substance.

an implantable analyte sensor configured to continuously monitor at least one analyte;
a sensor mounting unit, the implantable analyte sensor being coupled to the sensor mounting unit;
an adhesive pad coupled to the sensor mounting unit configured to adhere the sensor mounting unit to a skin surface of a host;
a plurality of heating elements heating element coupled to the adhesive pad; and

detecting that the analyte sensor has been inserted into a host[[;]], providing power to the heating element, plurality of heating elements; and
